verses.text: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
And when the stars fall, dispersing,
And when the mountains are removed
And when full-term she-camels[1] are neglected
And when the wild beasts are gathered
And when the seas are filled with flame[2]
And when the souls are paired[3]
And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
For what sin she was killed
And when the pages[4] are spread [i.e., made public]
And when the sky is stripped away
And when Hellfire is set ablaze
And when Paradise is brought near,
A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].[5]
So I swear by the retreating stars -
Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]
And by the night as it closes in[6]
And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]
[That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]
[Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.[7]
And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.[8]
And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.[9]
And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
So where are you going?[10]
It is not except a reminder to the worlds
For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.

footnotes.1: Those ten months pregnant and nearing delivery. This verse alludes to distraction from the most valued of possessions.
footnotes.2: Or "when the seas have overflowed [into each other]."
footnotes.3: With another like soul. It can also mean "joined" (with their groups or sects) .
footnotes.4: On which are recorded the deeds of all people.
footnotes.5: i.e., all of one's deeds from worldly life, which have accompanied the soul to the Hereafter.
footnotes.6: An alternative meaning is "as it departs."
footnotes.8: i.e., the eastern horizon, where the sun rises. See footnote to 53:6
footnotes.9: Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) did not withhold that knowledge of the unseen which Allāh had revealed to him in the Qur’ān.
footnotes.10: In your denial of the Qur’ān and in your accusations against the Prophet (ﷺ) . The meaning is essentially "Surely, you have strayed far from Allāh's path."
